sources.title: Minguinho-zeze/Qwen3-1.7B-NVFP4-RTN-WikiText2 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Quantization NVFP4 weights and FP4 input activations (W4A4), group size 16. Algorithm: RTN. The embedding, normalization layers, and lm_head remain unquantized. The quantized parameter fraction is 81.9079%. KV cache was BF16 during evaluation. Weights use compressed-tensors. Exact settings and quantizer versions are preserved in config.json, recipe.yaml, and quant_meta.json.
